```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
library(AURATHOMALAB9)
```

```{r}
# Probability Density Function at y = 0
dtrain(0)

# Cumulative Distribution Function at q = 1
ptrain(1)

# Quantile Function for probability p = 0.5 (Median)
qtrain(0.5)

# Generate a small random sample of train lateness times
set.seed(42)
samples <- rtrain(n = 5, u = 0.5)
samples
```
